# Catherine Andrews

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P30](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0030)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

_Not yet known._

## Personality

Catherine Andrews maintains an optimistic outlook on life, consistently striving to look on the bright side of situations. She acknowledges that keeping a positive attitude is necessary for her, particularly given her living arrangement with [Eliza](../character/eliza-andrews.md).

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P21](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0021), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P31](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0031)_

## History

During [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Diana's canvassing efforts for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), Catherine Andrews was visited at her home alongside her sister [Eliza](../character/eliza-andrews.md). Unlike her pessimistic sister, Catherine was notable for her optimistic disposition as the girls sought subscriptions for repairs to the local hall.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P2](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0002), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P6](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0006), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P11](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0011), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P13](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0013), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P17](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0017), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P18](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0018), +11 more_
